assertion_audit.fails_if: the chosen source is the wrong unknown type, radial flux basis differs from -2πRZ, or the declared coil direction is not retained
the inactive row is not zero or the active centroid row does not return 0.5 - 0.7 = -0.2
the typed request does not pass one CurrentCentroidConstraint pair to active.solve; it cannot fail on an error inside that mocked call
the test constant is below 1.6, even if carrier_map no longer makes an elongated state
the synthetic free solver stalls, misses literal 0.5 m, approaches either target, or leaves a nonzero compensator

the synthetic solve stalls, misses residual 1e-12, returns a different value of its supplied observation function, or gives identical field unknowns; a shared error in the supplied observation and assertion survives
the explicitly compiled synthetic program cannot execute all three bindings, stalls, or returns an observation differing from the same supplied target or FREE_HEIGHT

findings.text: the public-route test raises from a mock before assemble_augmented_system and Newton-Krylov execute, so a broken physical pin on a real ForwardSolveRequest would leave all five focused tests green.

the asserted height is computed by the same centroid_height function supplied to pinned_fixed_point; replacing that function with an unrelated state coordinate can move both sides together and keep the target assertion green.

the one-program claim is measured for the synthetic core and a public cache key, while the document admits no production augmented Newton-Krylov executable count; the done_when's production compilation measure remains unverified.
pin_residual and pinned_fixed_point duplicate the augmented constraint capability owned by constraint.py's AugmentedConstraintSystem and have no production caller, leaving two paths to maintain.
ELONGATION >= 1.6 checks only the test constant; removing elongation from carrier_map would leave this assertion green, so it does not independently guard the solved carrier shape.

the head topology module reached its summary with seven setup errors after an out-of-memory compiler child; zero added failure IDs is a valid set difference but those seven kernel behaviours remain unmeasured.
